action_authority: NONE on every row. Betting output is zero without a price overlay.
BUILDER_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_FIXED_BEFORE_RE: The first build of this card CAPped six starters silently. The pitcher-log directory holds three field widths (10, 8 and 7) and my parser assumed one, so every 10-field row raised on float('PHI') and was skipped; and I computed k and bb per NINE INNINGS when the repo's units are per BATTER FACED in percent. The independent information-class check — classifying the slate from the logs and comparing game by game against the board's own dose — caught it before this card was registered. Doses are now 8 FULL and 2 PARTIAL, matching the official page.
